question: How were foreigners who had settled among the Israelites and had children to be treated when the land was divided?
options: They were to be sent away
They could work but not own land
They were to receive an inheritance like native-born Israelites
They had to pay to stay
explanation: Foreigners who had settled among them and had children were to be considered as native-born Israelites and allotted an inheritance among the tribes.
